components.name: button
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: .45rem .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #91a79c); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--plane, #f3f6f3); color: var(--ink, #203a36); font: 550 .875rem/1.3 var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--plane-2, #e7eeea); border-color: var(--ink-3, #526962); } .ds-button:active { background: var(--plane-3, #dfe4e7); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #19766a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: button-primary
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: .45rem .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #91a79c); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--plane, #f3f6f3); color: var(--ink, #203a36); font: 550 .875rem/1.3 var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; background: var(--accent, #17665e); border-color: var(--accent, #17665e); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-2, #104c46); border-color: var(--accent-2, #104c46); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--plane-3, #dfe4e7); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #19766a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: button-small
components.css: .ds-button-small { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: .45rem .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #91a79c); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--plane, #f3f6f3); color: var(--ink, #203a36); font: 550 .875rem/1.3 var(--sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; min-height: 2rem; padding: .25rem .6rem; font-size: .8125rem; } .ds-button-small:hover { background: var(--plane-2, #e7eeea); border-color: var(--ink-3, #526962); } .ds-button-small:active { background: var(--plane-3, #dfe4e7); } .ds-button-small:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #19766a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: search
components.css: .ds-search { flex: 1 1 16rem; min-width: 0; min-height: 2.25rem; padding: .4rem .6rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #91a79c); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--plane, #f3f6f3); color: var(--ink, #203a36); font: inherit; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #19766a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: nav
components.css: .ds-nav { padding: .65rem 0; color: var(--ink-2, #445e58); font-weight: 550; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent } .ds-nav[aria-current=page] { color: var(--accent, #17665e); border-color: var(--accent, #17665e) } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #19766a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; margin-inline-start: .5rem; padding: .05rem .35rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #91a79c); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--ink-2, #445e58); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 550; vertical-align: .05em; }

narrative.overview: The fold journal puts conversations, provider readings and fold receipts on one ruled surface. A large estimate answers how much context was saved; a separate reading answers what the provider actually reported.
keyCharacteristics: A dark teal masthead in both schemes
Conversation rows paired with a dated receipt

rules.name: The Separate Readings Rule
rules.body: Keep estimated savings separate from provider-reported cache usage.

dos: Do name the denominator beside the provider percentage: input tokens for calls reporting both counts. Show read tokens, write tokens and reporting coverage separately.
Do keep language and lock controls clear of the host overlay.
donts: Don’t turn an absent reading into zero.
Don’t give the host overlay’s rounded card treatment to journal sections.
